task: Q2 compound-flavour Top-3 for all 50 panel sensory targets
purpose: Descriptive compound association ranking with bootstrap stability and A/B/C chemical evidence grading; no causal claim.

inputs.features: 1.csv non-meta columns (231 individual analytes and whole-beer chemistry parameters)
inputs.correlation: 2.csv 231x231 matrix; recomputed from 1.csv it is Spearman (max abs diff ~1e-16), not Pearson
inputs.targets: 4.csv non-meta columns (50 standardised panel sensory targets, no missing values)
inputs.cross_correlation: 6.csv 44 chemical rows x 50 sensory columns (independent empirical support; 44/44 rows map to 1.csv fields)

model.ranking: Ridge (alpha=1000) coefficients on the 219 individual-analyte candidates, then score = |coef| + 0.5 * mean(|coef|) over 2.csv graph neighbours
model.preprocessing: per-column median impute -> asinh -> standardise X; centre Y

stability.refit_scope: imputation, asinh, scaling, ridge and neighbourhood scores are recomputed in every replicate
metrics: bootstrap Top-3 Jaccard vs full data

evidence_grading.A: identity marker, or same mechanism family with same-sign 6.csv |r| >= 0.2, or direct mechanism class with bootstrap frequency >= 0.5
evidence_grading.B: same mechanism family (mechanism argument only), or same-sign 6.csv |r| >= 0.2 outside direct families
evidence_grading.confidence: high = A and frequency >= 0.5; medium = A/B and frequency >= 0.4; low = otherwise

previous_team_table.interpretation: 17/50 is the GBR raw-score sub-table, not Q2 coverage; the ridge sub-table already covers 50/50 targets
